title: Purity in the Camp

questions.question: Who was to be put out of the camp?
options: Lepers, those with a discharge, and those unclean by the dead
questions.correctAnswer: Lepers, those with a discharge, and those unclean by the dead
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:2 (ESV): "Put out of the camp everyone who is leprous or has a discharge and all who are unclean through contact with the dead."

questions.question: If a man or woman commits a sin against another, what must they do?
options: Pay a fine to the judge
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:7 (ESV): "He shall confess his sin... and he shall make full restitution for his wrong."

questions.question: How much must be added to the restitution?
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:7 (ESV): "Adding a fifth to it and giving it to him to whom he did the wrong."

questions.question: What is the "law of jealousy" concerning?
options: A husband suspecting his wife of adultery
questions.correctAnswer: A husband suspecting his wife of adultery
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:14 (ESV): "And if the spirit of jealousy comes over him and he is jealous of his wife..."

questions.question: Who performs the ritual for the suspected wife?
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:15 (ESV): "Then the man shall bring his wife to the priest..."

questions.question: What water is used in the test?
options: Holy water in an earthenware vessel
questions.correctAnswer: Holy water in an earthenware vessel
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:17 (ESV): "And the priest shall take holy water in an earthenware vessel..."

questions.question: What is mixed into the water?
options: Dust from the floor of the tabernacle
questions.correctAnswer: Dust from the floor of the tabernacle
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:17 (ESV): "And take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water."

questions.question: If the woman is guilty, what happens when she drinks?
options: Her womb shall swell and her thigh shall fall away
questions.correctAnswer: Her womb shall swell and her thigh shall fall away
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:27 (ESV): "The water... shall enter into her and cause bitter pain, and her womb shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away."

questions.question: If the woman is innocent, what happens?
options: She shall be free and shall conceive children
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be free and shall conceive children
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:28 (ESV): "But if the woman has not defiled herself... then she shall be free and shall conceive children."

questions.question: What offering does the husband bring for his wife?
options: Barley meal without oil or frankincense
questions.correctAnswer: Barley meal without oil or frankincense
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:15 (ESV): "A tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He shall pour no oil on it and put no frankincense on it."

questions.question: Why is no oil or frankincense put on the offering?
options: Because it is a grain offering of jealousy, invoking a remembrance of iniquity
It was a rule for barley
questions.correctAnswer: Because it is a grain offering of jealousy, invoking a remembrance of iniquity
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:15 (ESV): "For it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance, bringing iniquity to remembrance."

questions.question: What did the priest wash into the water?
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:23 (ESV): "Then the priest shall write these curses in a book and wash them off into the water of bitterness."

questions.question: To whom does the restitution go if the man has no kinsman redeemer?
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:8 (ESV): "If the man has no kinsman... the restitution... shall go to the Lord for the priest."

questions.question: Did this law apply to women suspecting husbands?
options: No, only jealousy over a wife
questions.correctAnswer: No, only jealousy over a wife
questions.explanation: The text specifically specifies "if a man's wife goes astray" (v12) and "jealous of his wife" (v14).

questions.question: Why purity in the camp?
options: That they may not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell
questions.correctAnswer: That they may not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell
questions.explanation: Numbers 5:3 (ESV): "That they may not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell."

key_verse_text: When a man or woman commits any of the sins that people commit by breaking faith with the Lord, and that person realizes his guilt, he shall confess his sin that he has committed.
